strategies.name: Naive 8-stage all-reduce loop
strategies.desc: Direct translation of the reference: 8 sequential all-reduce calls with interleaved local bidiagonal coupling/decoupling operations. 8 collective dispatches (one all-reduce per stage), straightforward but no optimization for overlapping communication or computation. Tradeoff: simplicity and correctness verification at the cost of maximum latency from sequential collectives.

strategies.name: Reduce-scatter then all-gather per stage
strategies.desc: Replace each all-reduce with reduce-scatter followed by all-gather, performing local bidiagonal operations only on the locally-owned shard between the two primitives. 16 collective dispatches (2 per stage × 8 stages). Tradeoff: smaller per-rank payloads during reduce-scatter (world_size × 2048 / world_size = 2048 per rank) but doubles the number of collective operations, potentially better bandwidth utilization on high-latency networks.

strategies.name: Fused bidiagonal transformation with all-reduce
strategies.desc: Merge the forward bidiagonal coupling into a single buffer preparation pass, then single all-reduce, then backward decoupling—repeat for all 8 stages but with vectorized local operations to maximize compute density between collectives. Still 8 collective dispatches but with optimized local computation (fused loops, better cache locality). Tradeoff: same collective count as naive but improved arithmetic intensity and memory access patterns.

strategies.name: Hierarchical two-level all-reduce (intra-node + inter-node)
strategies.desc: Exploit the multi-node topology by performing intra-node reductions first (across local devices), then inter-node reductions, then broadcast back within nodes for each of the 8 stages. 24 collective dispatches (3 per stage × 8 stages: intra-node reduce, inter-node all-reduce, intra-node broadcast). Tradeoff: leverages faster intra-node bandwidth (NVLink/local) versus slower inter-node (network), reducing cross-node traffic volume.

strategies.name: Pipelined overlapped communication-computation
strategies.desc:
Decompose the world_size × 2048 tensor into chunks and pipeline the all-reduce with bidiagonal operations: start all-reduce on chunk k while performing local coupling/decoupling on chunk k-1. Requires async collectives or manual chunking with multiple all-reduce calls. Approximately 8-16 collective dispatches depending on chunk granularity. Tradeoff: hides communication latency behind computation but increases code complexity and requires careful synchronization between pipeline stages.
